question: What is the time period of the rolling plan during the five-year plan in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1978 - 80**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The rolling plan was introduced during the tenure of the Janata Party government in India.
 
• It was implemented after the termination of the Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979).
 
• The rolling plan aimed at annual review and revision of the plan to adapt to the changing economic conditions and requirements.
 
• The rolling plan was in operation from 1978 to 1980 until it was replaced by the Sixth Five-Year Plan.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Five-Year Plans in India:**

 
 
• India's Five-Year Plans were centralized and integrated national economic programs.
 
• The first Five-Year Plan was launched in 1951, focusing on agricultural development.
 
• The plans aimed at strategic economic development and resource allocation.
 
• The Planning Commission of India was responsible for formulating and overseeing the plans.
 
 
 
• **Rolling Plan:**
 
 
• The rolling plan concept was introduced to allow flexibility and annual adjustments to the plans.
 
• It was an alternative to the rigid five-year framework, providing scope for course corrections based on economic performance and changing priorities.
 
• The rolling plan covered a period of two years from 1978 to 1980.
 
• It was eventually replaced by the Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-1985) when the Congress government returned to power.
